name: Julia Moloney
story: The Environmental Protection Authority profiles Julia Moloney as a Spatial Intelligence Analyst. It describes her study in physical geography and GIS at the University of Otago, interest in coastal geomorphology, and use of GIS to analyse and visualise location-based information for environmental work. The profile does not name a software platform or date her role.
